description: Apply a list of raw Google Slides API batchUpdate request objects (add slide, insert text/image, etc.) to a presentation. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the replies arrive via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Apply raw Google Slides API batchUpdate requests to an existing presentation by id as a background job - createSlide, insertText, createImage, updatePageElementTransform and the rest - passed through verbatim. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the raw replies. The low-level structural edit surface for decks.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the presentation batch update; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to apply structural edit requests to a Google Slides presentation.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, requests is empty/not a list of dicts, a request object is malformed per the Slides API, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the presentation id or a referenced object_id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty list of valid Slides API request objects. gsuite.not_found: use slides_get to confirm object_ids before referencing them. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
